text.p: The average yield at the latest auction of three-month discount treasury bills edged up to 57.30 against 57.25 percent at the last sale on September 26, a Ukrainian central bank official said on Friday.
The results of Thursday's auction, compared to the last issue of three-month T-bills, were as follows:
Amount sold 40.505 million UAH 11.920 million UAH
Actual amount raised 35.442 million UAH 10.431 million UAH
Ukraine's central bank sold 405,051 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 342,603 were competitive and 62,448 were non-competitive.
The date of the next auction of discount three-month T-bills is scheduled for October 1.
The average yield at the latest auction of six-month discount treasury bills edged down to 59.57 percent from 59.87 percent at the last sale on September 25, a central bank statement said.
The results of Thursday's auction, compared to the last issue of six-month discount T-bills, were as follows:
The central bank sold 2,984 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 16 were competitive and 2,968 were non-competitive.
The next auction of six-month discount T-bills is scheduled for October 1.
The average yield at the latest auction of 12-month discount treasury bills edged up to 62.11 percent from 61.96 percent at the last sale on September 25, a central bank statement said.
The results of Thursday's auction, compared to the last issue of 12-month discount T-bills, were as follows:
The central bank sold 2,800 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of 12-month discount T-bills is scheduled on October 1.
